navigation.initial_symbol: BTCUSDT unless symbolProvider already explicitly selected
navigation.session_return: Chosen chart/trade workspace and selected symbol survive bottom navigation and locale changes; Markets row selection returns to Futures for that symbol.
navigation.persistence: Session only. New application container resets navigation. No new durable order draft, route or financial configuration preference.
navigation.mounting: Only selected destination mounted; chart/demo subpanels preserve state within workspace tab changes. Returning from another destination remounts workspace while providers retain appropriate session state.
navigation.accessibility: Localized five destinations, selected/button semantics and minimum48px navigation touch height.

quick_panel.first_visit: Shown on chart tab, blank quantity/no percentage; both directions disabled until explicit valid private context and quantity.
quick_panel.unit: Matching signed context rules.baseAsset first; otherwise exact selected public AsterInstrument.base; absent/mismatched metadata gives unknown. No wallet creation or signature for public unit.
quick_panel.account_settings: Leverage, margin mode, position mode, asset mode and USDT available balance show unknown before read or when required fields absent; actual signed values thereafter, preserving decimal balance precision.
quick_panel.product_presets: Single asset/one-way/cross/10x are PRD product presets, not evidence of actual Aster account defaults. No automatic configuration writes or fake signed data.
quick_panel.read_boundary: User explicitly requests private context/sizing read; navigation, metadata, locale and placeholders do not sign or submit.
quick_panel.quotes: Buy reference ask, sell reference bid only from connected non-offline current feed. AsyncLoading/AsyncError suppress retained old quotes; fresh event restores. References are not specified execution prices.
quick_panel.independence: Quick base quantity remains independent of demo/main price and quantity. Existing percentage sizing, confirmation preferences, fixed MARKET protocol and original-ID recovery are unchanged.

architecture.application: Typed Riverpod destination and workspace selection; public matched-instrument provider.
architecture.presentation: Extracted FuturesWorkspace, bottom navigation and QuickOrderAccountSettings. Widgets render provider state and collect intent; no HTTP clients or financial calculations added.
architecture.reviews: New production files below400lines, new build methods below80lines. Existing MarketHeader long composed build reviewed; only extracted funding renderer placeholder behavior changes. Existing test fixture remains centralized wiring.
